featured_reviews.name: Ryan Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been here numerous times for swim meets and various events.

The 50M pool is very well maintained, clean and proper demarcation of lanes. Has a full 7 lanes with the 1st and 7th being extra wide.

Has a 5M diving board for diving facilities.

Clean and well kept wash amd changing rooms are provided.

Gets very crowded on weekends and holidays. Especially in the summer.

Coaching facilities are provided and has numerous staff on hand for any swimming and coaching requirements.

The canteen is a bit lacking in food and taste but does provide tea/coffee and light snacks.

The seating arrangements need improvement which is where I deducted 1 star. The seats are hard narrow and cramped and very little space to move or walk around.

Overall one of the best and well maintained pools in the suburbs and maintenance and cleanliness standards are very high.

featured_reviews.review_text: Top-notch facilities! The ozone water treatment makes a massive difference—super clean and great for sensitive skin. Friendly atmosphere and highly recommended!"

featured_reviews.review_text: Management for Ozone Swimming Pool Systems involves systematically collecting, analyzing, and acting on customer input. This helps improve satisfaction, address common issues like maintenance challenges or performance expectations, refine installations/services

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really a very nice pool managed by BMC.
It is a 50 metre olympics size pool which conducts training and hosts various interschool, district and state level events.

Apart from this they maintain a small pool for kids as well.

The Name is OZONE because they maintain Ozonized water in the pool.

The yearly training fee is very much affordable for a normal family as well. They just charge RS. 6800/- as regular fell and almost 1000/- extra for learners. Rs 18/- they charge as daily locker fee and one may opt for a yearly fee of RS 700.

45 mins slot and government staff approach is another prospect where you may feel little disappointed 😞☹️
Parking is also a concern here.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Tondwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone has two swimming pool. One for the kids and one for proper swimming.
The swimming pool is ozonized and it is well maintained.  There are many life guards for the safety of its members. The pool has maximum depth of 18 feet.

The pools water is really nice and it is one of the cleanest pools in the locality. As a swimmer one can get yearly membership at 6764/- and for learners it is extra 1000/-.

One member has to select one of the batches available and then has to come only during that particular batch only.  There is no particular parking space for two / four wheeler so one has to park on the road at their own risk.

Locker facility is available at 18/- per day basis or a yearly fee if 720/-.

featured_reviews.review_text: Have joined the last summer camp with my daughter in Ozone swimming pool, near vivek college, Goregaon west. Have taken morning batch from 9 am to 10 am. The pool is open from morning 9 am to evening 7 pm. Open for all ages. The trainers are good here. The pool has different sizes, it start from 3 feet to 18 feet. Now a days me and my daughter is using floaters for swimming 🏊‍♀️. The morning time is little busy. Can take yearly membership for Rs 7000.

featured_reviews.name: Лилия
featured_reviews.review_text:
After receiving multiple advertisements for swimming classes at Michael Phelps, I enrolled my child in a trial class, eager to see if it would be a good fit for our family. However, after the trial class, I was informed that the school is fully booked and cannot accommodate my child in the regular sessions.

This experience has been frustrating and very misleading. It is disappointing to realize that despite the time and effort spent attending the trial class, there was no possibility of enrolling my child in your program due to the lack of available spots. This crucial information was not communicated to us beforehand, this should be clearly stated prior to booking trial classes.

Advertising trial classes when there are no available spots for regular enrollment is fraudulent and unprofessional. It creates false hopes and wastes valuable time for both parents and children.

I urge you to review this and ensure that clear and transparent communication is provided in the future. Prospective clients should be informed of the availability of spots before enrolling in any trial classes to avoid such disappointments.

featured_reviews.name: Meghana Gune
featured_reviews.review_text:

1) The coaches very well understand how to handle the kids and encourage them
2) My kid has overcome the fear of swimming in just a few sessions
3) Individual attention as coach and student ratio of 1:6 is followed
4) The progress of every child is monitored on a regular basis. So the parents also get to know how much a child has learnt.

featured_reviews.name: Chintan Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Coach Omkar’s dedication and tireless effort have transformed my once-fearful child into a confident swimmer. I am immensely grateful for Coach Omkar’s hard work and expertise, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking a compassionate and skilled swimming coach.

He repeatedly taught the same movements  over and over again with a smile on his face and helping my son gradually overcome his fears. Finally, my son has learnt swimming and happy with his progress. This is a great place to help your kid learning swimming. Thank you Omkar-sir!!

featured_reviews.name: Shlok Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a life member of GSC for many years and overall it’s been a great place to be. The food quality is consistently good, and the gym is well-equipped with everything needed for a solid workout. The trainers and facilities are generally well maintained.

The club also offers excellent wellness amenities including steam, sauna, and other recreational facilities, which add a lot of value to the membership.

The only downside is that the gym can get quite crowded during peak hours. More importantly, health and hygiene standards in certain areas need to be taken more seriously. While the steam and sauna facilities are good, they sometimes have a lingering smell of oils and can feel a bit stuffy, especially when heavily used. More frequent cleaning, better ventilation, and closer attention to hygiene would significantly improve the overall experience.

That said, GSC continues to offer a strong overall experience, and as a life member, I feel it remains one of the better clubs in the city for fitness, dining, and family recreation.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Goregaon Sports Club is a fantastic place for fitness, fun, and relaxation! 🏸🏊‍♂️ The club offers great indoor and outdoor games, a clean and refreshing swimming pool, and a lovely restaurant serving delicious food. Perfect spot to unwind with family and friends! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Amberdeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the Best sports club in this part of city which actually dedicates good amount of resources for sports and culturalactivities. GSC is loaded with lots of sports and general amenities. They have massive sport ground for cricket and other social events, Olympic size 10 lane swimming pool, separate pools for kids and even totally separate diving pool too. There are couple of basketball courts, multiple lawn tennis, squash and badminton courts. They even have 4 lane pistol shooting range and facilities for gymnastics, calisthenics, crossfit training, boxing and of course a big gym. There is a 500 meter walking track lined with trees and flowers making your walking experience pleasant. You can enjoy variety of food at their different restaurants and food courts. They even have a Library here with good collection of books with accessibility for non-members too. The staff here is very helpful and always there to offer their assistance. The washrooms are never far off as they are located all around the club and always clean and tidy. The club can accommodate good number of car in it's parking.

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently completely refurbished and opened back to the general public.

Pool - 50 Metre Olympic spec. size with starting boards and lane markings (underwater).
Max depth- 17 Feet
Minimum Depth - 4 Feet
Lanes - 10
Access ladders - 6

The pool itself is very very good. The water is clean, minimal chlorine and no skin infections or rashes like you sometimes get with dirty water. The water filters seem to be working effectively.
Rules
Only swimers allowed onto the swim area level and around the pool.
Swimming costume is compulsory.

The facilities are well maintained, the staff are helpful and the overall experience is very good.

Timings
Morning 06.00am to 11.00am
Ladies 11.00am to 12.00pm

Evening 06.00pm to 10.00pm
Ladies 05.00 to 06.00pm

Overall Swimming Experience - 3/5

The Swimming experience itself is quite a mess. Filled with senior citizens/ middle-aged aged men with absolutely no sense of how a swimming pool works.
This is comparable to Mumbai traffic but in water.
People swim in any direction, breadth wise, diagonal wise, criss-crossing from anywhere and just getting into each other's way. There is absolutely no concept of swimming in a 50M pool and the crowd is comparable to a Waterpark on weekends.

If you're a casual swimmer just looking to get wet on a hot summers day then it's perfect.

If you're a professional swimmer looking to put in some practice laps when not coaching, then you will be disappointed.

It's impossible to actually swim 50M uninterrupted. Whatever the batch time.

The BMC should allocate a set timing slot morning/evening for serious swimmers only. Easier said than done though as its a common pool and arguments are bound to arise.

Overall the facilities are very good and the experience is nice but for competition level swimmers looking for extra practice it's not worth the time.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Swimming Pool is fantastic after renovation! The Olympic-size pool is clean, and the changing rooms and lockers are well-maintained. The best part is the affordable pricing, making it accessible for everyone. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Vasanth Pragash
featured_reviews.review_text:
November 2025 review

Pool is big and possibly olympic size. The pool has various depths starting from shallow end of 4 feet to over 15 feet depth. The pool is trifurcated into three areas, 1) Shallow end ,2) 2 Full length lanes( this reduces the width of the pool for the other 2) 3) Main pool area. Small lockers, shower rooms etc are available at no extra cost.

Membership process:
Full the details online in the website, be sure to upload aadhaar and pay the amount. For verification you will need aadhaar copy, printout of 2 receipts(one will become your id), original copy of doctors medical certificate stating you have no skin diseases or communicable diseases and are fit to swim, and three passport photos.They will take aadhaar copy, both receipt copies,the doctors medical certificate and photos. You will recive an SMS that registration is done and they will give you back one stamped receipt with your photo as your medical id. Laminate it or keep it in a ziplock bag.

Advantages:
1) Very friendly staff. They are extremely courteous and helpful in resolving pool queries and so on.
2) Very convenient timings. 6AM-12 noon (11-12 ladies only) and 5-10PM (5-6PM ladies only)
3) Pool is maintained very clean despite its public nature.

Disadvantages:
1) Nothing is provided, no soap, towels or paper.
2) You will need to bring your own locks, lockers are very small so make sure you buy a small lock.
3) Restrictions apply on swimwear , no full body suits for anyone and men can only wear swim shorts. No cotton shorts, etc allowed. If you come in morning you can buy swimming shorts, goggles and swim caps from the reception but it could be expensive.
4) Pool is extremely clorinated, and you can feel it in your teeth and hair. Be sure to brush and clean yourself as soon as your done with swimming. No shower doors for showers.
5) This is a public pool, which means a lot of people will be using it, this is understandable but can cause problems if your trying to swim laps as many kids/adults will crash your path. If this is the case stick to pool area 2).

Best time to swim would be 9-11 in the morning as a guy, most people are working and the sun is bright such that the pool isn't too cold.

If you’re reading this then I want to say thank you 🙏 for your time. Incase you see me working out here then do come over and say hello 👋

Cheers guys enjoy your workouts.. 🤗
